cohort: 4,987,390 singletons surviving their first year of life, including 671,646 CS deliveries and 31,073 ASD children
finding: Both emergency and planned CS were consistently associated with a modest increased risk of ASD from gestational weeks 36 to 42 compared with vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Both emergency and planned CS showed a similar increased risk of ASD compared to vaginal delivery.
